Since it’s a new checking account at this bank, it just hasn’t been linked to your online profile yet. I can’t attach it for you directly from here, but you can usually add it in one of these ways (varies slightly by bank):

1) Online banking (website)
- Sign in and go to something like “Profile,” “Settings,” or “Accounts.”
- Look for “Link an existing account,” “Add an account,” or “Add relationship.”
- You’ll typically need one or more of:
  - The new account number  
  - Routing number (if asked)  
  - Some verification info (e.g., last 4 of SSN, DOB, or a one-time code)

2) Mobile app
- Open the app and sign in.
- Tap your profile icon or “Accounts.”
- Look for an option such as “Add account” / “Link existing account with us.”
- Enter the new checking account details and confirm.

3) Call or visit a branch
- Tell them: “I opened a new checking account and it’s not showing in my online banking. Can you link it to this login?”
- They may ask you to confirm:
  - Your online banking username
  - The new account number
  - Security questions/ID

Once it’s linked, I can pull the real‑time balance for you here.
